## Scope

This vignette documents a completed **new reconstructed experiment** of all
1,000 seeds, not a verified continuation of the original 100-seed study. Each seed
ran 360 epochs using unchanged package **7.3.0** at
`a95bc8dda84c4eb35633ee5a5bb456169c1c54b8`. Version 7.3.18 adds this research
record and vignette links; it does not claim the experiment trained with 7.3.18.
This document reads saved results and does not launch training.

## Frozen setup

Use the repository heart-failure CSV and all 12 predictors in column order.
Training rows are 1–3500, validation 3501–4250, and test 4251–5000. Standardize all
splits using training means/sample SDs and the training standardized maximum
absolute-value divisor. One 12→64→32→1 network uses ReLU/ReLU/sigmoid, He
initialization with custom_scale 1.04349, standard AdaGrad with fixed rate .125,
L1 .00028, dropout list(.1,NULL,NULL), epsilon 1e-7 and native class weights 2/1.
There is no additional input normalization, batch normalization, self-organization
or sequence encoding. The unchanged native member trainer avoids the fit
wrapper's extra normalization. The first strictly best validation accuracy at .5
selects both weights and biases; all 360 epochs run. Test predictions use >= .5.
No test-driven tuning, early stopping or seed selection is used.

## Observed fixed-split results

| Metric | Mean | Sample SD |
|---|---:|---:|
| accuracy | 0.999705333333 | 0.000631588309488 |
| precision | 0.999183358325 | 0.0019145390445 |
| recall | 0.999855895197 | 0.000850676417924 |
| f1 | 0.999518373615 | 0.00103175565633 |
| roc_auc | 0.99999779564 | 1.79812778671e-05 |
| log_loss | 0.0195290555375 | 0.00861872593884 |
| brier | 0.0029222402564 | 0.00160942267848 |

There were **221 errors** across 750,000 repeated seed-by-test-row predictions:
188 false positives and 33 false negatives. Fifteen of the fixed 750 test rows
were misclassified at least once. Aggregate counts were TP 228967, TN 520812,
FP 188 and FN 33. Values in the table are fractions, not percentages.

All 20 archived source/dataset checksums matched. Two fresh-process seed-1 pilots
matched initialization, RNG states, all 360 validation accuracies, final/selected
checkpoints and predictions exactly. Restoring deliberately perturbed weights
and biases, fresh-process model reload and all 1,000 production artifact manifests
passed. Arithmetic/reference tests passed 12,162 assertions without failures or
skips. The supervisor rejected a tampered prediction file. ROC direction is fixed
with positive class 1; log loss clips only to [1e-15, 1-1e-15]. Undefined ratios
are NA; the full report records missing counts and all quantiles.

## Historical comparison and overlap

Standard **AdaGrad** is an optimizer, not automatic differentiation. The verified
legacy multilayer path applied a direct weight subtraction followed by an
additional adaptive update. Standard AdaGrad removes that double weight update.
Archived legacy probability-recomputed mean accuracy is 0.999218666666667,
with sample SD 0.00125609022428344 and 586 repeated prediction errors. The new
mean is 0.04866667 percentage points higher, with 365 fewer repeated errors.
These are descriptive differences: historical initialization, RNG, software and
complete execution conditions remain incompletely verified, so the change cannot
be attributed solely to the optimizer correction.

Correcting the optimizer does not correct the historical data split. Both sides
of the historical DDESONN/Keras comparison remain compromised by the overlap-heavy
heart-failure dataset; this is not a clean, fully matched comparison. Keras was
not rerun here. Its archived workbook reports count 1,000, but the data sheet has
1,001 rows with seed label 100 repeated. Workbook statistics are retained as
archived evidence without silently removing rows.

The overlap audit found 1,319 distinct feature vectors in 5,000 rows;
734/750 validation and 738/750 test feature vectors match training inputs. Only
12 test rows have inputs absent from training. The cause has not been established;
no patient identities or reasons for duplication are inferred. The same 750 test
rows recur across all seeds. These 750,000 predictions are not independent
clinical cases, and seed SD is not a patient-population confidence interval.

“We identified substantial overlap between training and test inputs, but its cause has not been established. After this iteration, we will rerun the 1,000-seed benchmark for both Keras and DDESONN using new splits that prevent identical feature vectors from appearing across training, validation, and testing. Both methods will use the same splits for a fair comparison.”

The split fix and matched rerun are **future work for a separate PR/task**.
This iteration deliberately retains the historical split.
